Land Requiring Body submits acquisition: Land Requiring Body submits acquisition proposal. District Collector reviews land necessity, scope, and affected families.
State Government mandates Social Impact: State Government mandates Social Impact Assessment. SIA team conducts study with public hearings at Gram Sabha/Municipality level.
Collector prepares draft Rehabilitation: Collector prepares draft Rehabilitation & Resettlement Scheme. R&R Commissioner reviews and formally approves the scheme per Sec 16-17.
State Government issues preliminary noti: State Government issues preliminary notification in the Official Gazette declaring intent to acquire land. Land use is frozen from this date.
District Collector holds formal hearing: District Collector holds formal hearing of objections from affected landowners and interested parties regarding the acquisition scope and compensation.
State Government issues formal declarati: State Government issues formal declaration of acquisition in the Official Gazette within 12 months of preliminary notification.
Land Acquisition Officer determines comp: Land Acquisition Officer determines compensation based on market value, multiplier factor, and assets. Issues formal award per Sec 23.
Compensation disbursed to landowners via: Compensation disbursed to landowners via PFMS / Direct Benefit Transfer. 100% Solatium and 12% interest added to the base value.
Collector takes physical possession of l: Collector takes physical possession of land free from all encumbrances. Land vests absolutely in Government. Mutation completed.
Cadastral survey, ground demarcation, bo: Cadastral survey, ground demarcation, boundary verification and digital GIS tagging of proposed land parcels per Section 12.
